297: 
298:         if text:
299:             ann = ax.annotate(
300:                 lab,
301:                 xy=(ival[0], height),
302:                 xycoords=transform,
303:                 xytext=(8, -10),
304:                 textcoords="offset points",
305:                 **text_kw,
306:             )
307:             ann.set_clip_path(rect)
308: 
309:     return ax
310: 
311: 
312: def labeled_intervals(
313:     intervals,
314:     labels,
315:     label_set=None,
316:     base=None,
317:     height=None,
318:     extend_labels=True,
319:     ax=None,
320:     tick=True,
321:     prop_cycle=None,
322:     **kwargs,
323: ):
324:     """Plot labeled intervals with each label on its own row.
325: 
326:     Parameters
327:     ----------
328:     intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
329:         segment intervals, in the format returned by
330:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_intervals` or
331:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
332: 
333:     labels : list, shape=(n,)
334:         reference segment labels, in the format returned by
335:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
336: 
337:     label_set : list
338:         An (ordered) list of labels to determine the plotting order.
339:         If not provided, the labels will be inferred from
340:         ``ax.get_yticklabels()``.
341:         If no ``yticklabels`` exist, then the sorted set of unique values
342:         in ``labels`` is taken as the label set.
343: 
344:     base : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), optional
345:         Vertical positions of each label.
346:         By default, labels are positioned at integers
347:         ``np.arange(len(labels))``.
348: 
349:     height : scalar or np.ndarray, shape=(n,), optional
350:         Height for each label.
351:         If scalar, the same value is applied to all labels.
352:         By default, each label has ``height=1``.
353: 
354:     extend_labels : bool
355:         If ``False``, only values of ``labels`` that also exist in
356:         ``label_set`` will be shown.
357: 
358:         If ``True``, all labels are shown, with those in `labels` but
359:         not in `label_set` appended to the top of the plot.
360:         A horizontal line is drawn to indicate the separation between
361:         values in or out of ``label_set``.
362: 
363:     ax : matplotlib.pyplot.axes
364:         An axis handle on which to draw the intervals.
365:         If none is provided, a new set of axes is created.
366: 
367:     tick : bool
368:         If ``True``, sets tick positions and labels on the y-axis.
369: 
370:     prop_cycle : cycle.Cycler
371:         An optional property cycle object to specify style properties.
372:         If not provided, the default property cycler will be retrieved from matplotlib.
373: 
374:     **kwargs
375:         Additional keyword arguments to pass to
376:         `matplotlib.collection.PolyCollection`.
377: 
378:     Returns
379:     -------
380:     ax : matplotlib.pyplot.axes._subplots.AxesSubplot
381:         A handle to the (possibly constructed) plot axes
382:     """
383:     # Get the axes handle
384:     ax, new_axes = __get_axes(ax=ax)
385: 
386:     if prop_cycle is None:
387:         __AXMAP[ax].setdefault("prop_cycle", mpl.rcParams["axes.prop_cycle"])
388:         __AXMAP[ax].setdefault("prop_iter", iter(mpl.rcParams["axes.prop_cycle"]))
389:     elif "prop_iter" not in __AXMAP[ax]:
390:         __AXMAP[ax]["prop_cycle"] = prop_cycle
391:         __AXMAP[ax]["prop_iter"] = iter(prop_cycle)
392: 
393:     prop_cycle = __AXMAP[ax]["prop_cycle"]
394:     prop_iter = __AXMAP[ax]["prop_iter"]
395: 
396:     # Make sure we have a numpy array
397:     intervals = np.atleast_2d(intervals)
398: 
399:     if label_set is None:
400:         # If we have non-empty pre-existing tick labels, use them
401:         # If none of the label strings have content, treat it as empty
402:         label_set = __AXMAP[ax].get("labels", [])
403:     else:
404:         label_set = list(label_set)
405: 
406:     # Put additional labels at the end, in order
407:     extended = False
408:     if extend_labels:
409:         ticks = label_set + sorted(set(labels) - set(label_set))
410:         if ticks != label_set and len(label_set) > 0:
411:             extended = True
412:     elif label_set:
413:         ticks = label_set
414:     else:
415:         ticks = sorted(set(labels))
416: 
417:     # Push the ticks up into the axmap
418:     __AXMAP[ax]["labels"] = ticks
419: 
420:     style = dict(linewidth=1)
421: 
422:     try:
423:         properties = next(prop_iter)
424:     except StopIteration:
425:         prop_iter = iter(prop_cycle)
426:         __AXMAP[ax]["prop_iter"] = prop_iter
427:         properties = next(prop_iter)
428: 
429:     style = {
430:         k: v
431:         for k, v in properties.items()
432:         if k in ["color", "facecolor", "edgecolor", "linewidth"]
433:     }
434:     # Swap color -> facecolor here so we preserve edgecolor on rects
435:     style.setdefault("facecolor", style["color"])
436:     style.pop("color", None)
437:     style.update(kwargs)
438: 
439:     if base is None:
440:         base = np.arange(len(ticks))
441: 
442:     if height is None:
443:         height = 1
444: 
445:     if np.isscalar(height):
446:         height = height * np.ones_like(base)
447: 
448:     seg_y = dict()
449:     for ybase, yheight, lab in zip(base, height, ticks):
450:         seg_y[lab] = (ybase, yheight)
451: 
452:     xvals = defaultdict(list)
